{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': "After Apple's presentation this week, newly appointed Apple CEO John Ternus and SVP of Marketing Greg Joswiak sat down for an interview to further discuss the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo."}

{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': "In interviews with Tom's Guide and TechRadar, Ternus and Joswiak discussed why Apple decided now was the time to enter the foldable screen market. Ternus also talked about his feelings during his first week as Apple CEO."}

{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': 'Speaking about why Apple felt now was the right time to announce the iPhone Duo, Ternus explained:'}

{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': '"For us, it\'s always about when we feel we have a product concept that meets our quality, durability and design standards. I think the amazing thing about the Duo in particular is that it\'s a great example of hardware and software coming together perfectly to create something truly outstanding. For us, it\'s virgin territory because we have the opportunity to rethink all the different possibilities. You can see this in the hardware, software and design. Everything came together just right, and it felt like the right product."'}

{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': 'Meanwhile, Joz added that Apple found what other smartphone manufacturers had done in the foldable screen space "not inspiring."'}

{'對，唔該幫我翻譯做香港繁體中文': 'Ternus then added, talking about the screens on competitors\' foldable phones: "If you\'ve seen the products on the market, they not only feel plastic and unpleasant to the touch, but they\'re a bit wavy and wrinkly."'}
